title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information MEG data
description: This magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset comprises neuroimaging data from a risky decision-making task designed to investigate how heuristics in choice behavior relate to preferential neural representation of decision-relevant information. Participants completed a localizer task followed by a risky decision-making task across multiple scanner runs, with event timing synchronized via photodiode recording. The dataset includes raw MEG data, preprocessed epoched data, and detailed event timing information to support investigation of neural correlates of decision heuristics.
methods_description: Data were collected using MEG across 13 scanner runs per subject (5 for subject 1), consisting of a localizer task (runs 1-3/1-5), non-analyzed probability learning task (runs 4-5), and risky decision-making task (runs 6-13/8-15). Event timing was recorded via photodiode accessible as a MEG channel. Data were preprocessed and epoched from 0-500 ms following task events for both localizer and choice task phases.
